name: Spicy Crunch Salmon Roll (Spicy/Seed Warning)
whyItWorks: Minced raw salmon tossed in chili oil and sriracha mayo, rolled with toasted sesame seeds and topped with deep-fried tempura flakes. The capsaicin irritates ulcerations while fried tempura flakes act as abrasive roughage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Spicy & Fried Warning: Avoid during active flare-ups. Order a simple salmon avocado roll or salmon nigiri instead.
